from __future__ import annotations

import json
import uuid

import pytest

from architect_t2_regressions import (
    workspace, OLD, NEW, NEW_PDF, accepted, refused, canonical, library,
)


def sequence(workspace):
    notes = (workspace / 'papers' / OLD / 'notes.md').read_bytes()
    first = accepted(library.archive_paper(workspace, 'sha256:' + OLD))
    restored = accepted(library.restore_paper(workspace, first['archive_id']))
    replaced = accepted(library.replace_paper(workspace, 'sha256:' + OLD, NEW_PDF))
    payload = workspace / '.light-library/archive' / replaced['archive_id'] / 'paper'
    assert (payload / 'notes.md').read_bytes() == notes
    return first, restored, replaced, payload


@pytest.mark.parametrize('later_archive_restore', [False, True])
def test_same_paper_restore_then_replace_history_is_proven(workspace, later_archive_restore):
    first, restored, replaced, payload = sequence(workspace)
    if later_archive_restore:
        later = accepted(library.archive_paper(workspace, 'sha256:' + NEW))
        accepted(library.recover_library(workspace))
        accepted(library.restore_paper(workspace, later['archive_id']))
    before = {p.relative_to(workspace).as_posix(): p.read_bytes()
              for p in workspace.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    result = accepted(library.recover_library(workspace))
    assert result['operations'] and all(row['ok'] is True for row in result['operations'])
    repeated = accepted(library.replace_paper(workspace, 'sha256:' + OLD, NEW_PDF))
    assert repeated['reused'] is True
    assert repeated['archive_id'] == replaced['archive_id']
    after = {p.relative_to(workspace).as_posix(): p.read_bytes()
             for p in workspace.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert after == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize('tamper', ['duplicate-successor', 'event-id', 'retained-note', 'missing-payload'])
def test_restore_replace_requires_unique_exact_retained_successor(workspace, tamper):
    first, restored, replaced, payload = sequence(workspace)
    if tamper == 'duplicate-successor':
        path = workspace / '.light-library/operations' / (replaced['operation_id'] + '.json')
        value = json.loads(path.read_text())
        new_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
        value['operation_id'] = new_id
        value['owned_relative_paths'] = [p.replace(replaced['operation_id'], new_id)
                                         for p in value['owned_relative_paths']]
        (path.parent / (new_id + '.json')).write_bytes(canonical(value) + b'\n')
    elif tamper == 'event-id':
        path = payload.parent / 'event.json'
        value = json.loads(path.read_text())
        value['operation_id'] = uuid.uuid4().hex
        path.write_bytes(canonical(value) + b'\n')
    elif tamper == 'retained-note':

    after = {p.relative_to(workspace).as_posix(): p.read_bytes()
             for p in workspace.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
